description: Audit the key structure of a locale file against a contract the caller states. Reports a message that is also the prefix of another message, which a loader nesting on the separator cannot hold both of so it keeps one and drops the other; two keys differing only in case, which is two keys to the file and one to any case-insensitive platform; a doubled separator, which resolves to a different key than written; and whitespace in a key, which several loaders trim or reject. Pay 130000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

key_pattern.description: A pattern every key segment must match. Character classes, anchors and simple quantifiers only: groups, alternation and escapes are refused so matching is cheap by construction.

require_flat.description: Report any nested key. Defaults to false.

separator.description: The separator a loader nests on. Defaults to a dot.

messages.description: The locale file. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

name: locale_nesting_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every key satisfied the contract and nothing was left unread.

depth_distribution.description: How many keys sit at each depth, which is how an inconsistent structure becomes visible.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Locale Nesting Contract Audit
